_: Dates checked by hand, overriding what the extractor guessed.
Same discipline as the accessories. The extractor reads a year out of
Michael's prose; prose about lenses is full of years belonging to other
things, most often the reflex version of a lens rather than the lens, or
the arrival of Visifocus rather than the lens that carries it. Every
candidate was read back against its sentence and the misses looked for.
year: null means the prose states no date of introduction for this lens,

swita.note: The lens 'was first manufactured in the 1940s'. The 1956 is when the RX version appeared, not the lens.

yvar-25mm-f-1-8-visifocus.note: 'Appears to have been introduced in 1958 or 1959.' He would not pick between them, so neither does this.

pizar-50mm-f-1-8-visifocus-st-and-rx-ver.note: 'Introduced in the late 1959.' Missed by the patterns because of the stray 'the'.
